items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: But I've heard his records, but I don't know him. Never saw him.

ctx.x: This fellow that died. I knew he was in New York, is all I knew he might have. I don't know him. Eight years.
But I've heard his records, but I don't know him. Never saw him. Otherwise, Fritz and Bechet played enough clarinet for me.
Because he's natural players, I guess. Natural talent for him. That's right.
